about: 2011 Census Basic Community Profile B01/B07/B08A/B08B/B09/B14/B24/B25/B26/B28/B32/B40B/B45B/B46 SA1 tables, pooled to Victoria's 88 state electoral districts for the 29 November 2014 election (the 2013 redistribution's boundaries — vic14 shares vic18's district set, the census edition moved; 2011 predates the GCP series, so the BCP — the GCP's own pre-2016 form — is the read). Each SA1 counts whole to the district its polygon representative point lies in (boundary SA1s are not split; the state total is never moved). Bases match the federal stores (ex-not-stated): language other than English over English-only+other stated; age shares renormalised over B01's 11 bands (which exclude age-not-stated); overseas-born over country-stated — the B09 birthplace table merges England and Scotland into one UK row, so the curated birthplace map prints the federal 2011-era stores' eight-country set (cob, order in cobKeys) rather than the GCP-era ten; university (bachelor and above, B40B) over the B01 aged-15+ population less level-of-education-not-stated; blue-collar (trades, machinery operators and drivers, labourers, B45B) over the eight stated ANZSCO groups; the new lane set mirrors the federal 2011-era stores (year-12-or-less over B01's six printed stated schooling levels; B07 Tot-row Indigenous/ Indigenous-plus-non-Indigenous; B14's Religion menu ten shares (rel, key order in relKeys) over the ex-affiliation-not-stated persons basis; B32's Housing-tenure menu four shares (ten, key order in tenKeys) over the ex-tenure-not-stated occupied-private-dwellings basis; B25's one-parent share of families; the under-15 share of the stated ages). Income lanes are the 2011 edition's 14-band grid in 2011 dollars (its $4,000+ open top band is the same dollar edge the GCP grids pin), the state-universe quantile cuts Victoria's own. p is census persons; n the SA1 count. The four Vic sentinel SA1s (migratory/offshore) carry no polygon and sit outside the join, holding 8341 persons statewide.
